_ordering_rationale: AMD restructure ses segments en 2022 (acquisition Xilinx avril 2022 + Pensando). 4 segments: Data Center (vedette IA via MI300X), Client (Ryzen), Gaming (consoles + GPU), Embedded (Xilinx). FY20-FY21 ne sont pas comparables (old structure CG+EESC).

kpis.signal: Joyau AMD, GPU MI300X/MI325X pour IA training/inference, croissance explosive concurrence NVDA
kpis.description_fr: Segment Data Center: EPYC CPU serveurs + Instinct MI300 GPU IA + DPU Pensando. Pilier strategique vs Intel et NVDA. Doublement FY24 sur boom IA generative.
kpis.description_en: Data Center segment: EPYC server CPU + Instinct MI300 AI GPU + Pensando DPU. Strategic vs Intel and NVDA. FY24 doubled on generative AI boom.

kpis.signal: Ryzen CPU desktop+laptop, rebond 2024 post-crash 2023, gains parts vs Intel + IA PC Copilot+
kpis.description_fr: Segment Client: processeurs Ryzen desktop et laptop (consumer + commercial). Rebond +52% FY24 vs effondrement 2023, gains parts marche vs Intel + cycle IA PC.
kpis.description_en: Client segment: Ryzen desktop and laptop CPUs (consumer + commercial). +52% FY24 rebound vs 2023 collapse, market share gains vs Intel + AI PC cycle.

kpis.signal: Crash -58% FY24, fin de cycle semi-custom PS5/Xbox + decroissance Radeon discrete GPU
kpis.description_fr: Segment Gaming: semi-custom chips Sony PS5 / Microsoft Xbox + Radeon discrete GPU. Fort declin FY24 (-58%) fin de cycle consoles et faiblesse discrete GPU.
kpis.description_en: Gaming segment: semi-custom chips Sony PS5 / Microsoft Xbox + Radeon discrete GPUs. Sharp FY24 decline (-58%) end of console cycle and discrete GPU weakness.

kpis.signal: Heritage acquisition Xilinx FY22 (avril 22), correction inventaires 2024 mais base installee solide
kpis.description_fr: Segment Embedded: FPGA + SoC Xilinx (acquis avril 2022), Pensando DPU. FY24 -33% correction inventaires post-boom, mais 2025 reprise attendue.
kpis.description_en: Embedded segment: Xilinx FPGAs + SoCs (acquired April 2022), Pensando DPU. FY24 -33% inventory correction post-boom, 2025 recovery expected.

kpis.signal: Marge segment ~28% FY24, boom IA inference + EPYC, levier scale produits MI300
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel segment Data Center. Marge ~28% FY24 en hausse. Levier scale GPU IA MI300 + cycle EPYC Turin.
kpis.description_en: Data Center segment operating income. ~28% margin FY24 expanding. Scale leverage on MI300 AI GPU + EPYC Turin cycle.

_notes: Donnees 10-K AMD FY22-FY24 (nouvelle segmentation post-Xilinx avril 2022). FY21 fournie pour Data Center Revenue/Op Income (rebase). Pas de comparable FY20 (old structure Computing+Graphics / EESC).
